changelog: New voice command "delete last paragraph" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ মুছে ফেলো") and the whole last paragraph is deleted, so a paragraph that came out wrong no longer needs line-by-line deleting or wiping the whole message. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 43 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
